tool_input.description: Recreate all masking policies with CURRENT_ROLE
tool_input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE MASKING POLICY KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.mask_pii_varchar
  AS (val VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR ->
  CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() IN ('RIA_FULL_ACCESS', 'ACCOUNTADMIN') THEN val ELSE '***MASKED***' END;

CREATE OR REPLACE MASKING POLICY KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.mask_pii_email
  AS (val VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR ->
  CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() IN ('RIA_FULL_ACCESS', 'ACCOUNTADMIN') THEN val ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(val, 1), '****@', SPLIT_PART(val, '@', 2)) END;

CREATE OR REPLACE MASKING POLICY KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.mask_pii_phone
  AS (val VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR ->
  CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() IN ('RIA_FULL_ACCESS', 'ACCOUNTADMIN') THEN val ELSE CONCAT('***-***-', RIGHT(val, 4)) END;

CREATE OR REPLACE MASKING POLICY KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.mask_pii_date
  AS (val DATE) RETURNS DATE ->
  CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() IN ('RIA_FULL_ACCESS', 'ACCOUNTADMIN') THEN val ELSE DATE_FROM_PARTS(YEAR(val), 1, 1) END
